card.name: Mixing steps in preparation instructions
card.fires_on: Words such as "and" or a period right after an instruction to add or pour something into a liquid, where a mixing verb (shake, stir, mix) comes next. Seen in drug preparation and reconstitution directions.

modes.label: "and" before shake
modes.description: The word "and" after an add-to-volume or add-liquid step, just before "shake" or "stir".

modes.description: A sentence-ending period after contents are emptied or diluted, where the next sentence is a mixing step.
